summary: Iteration 14 frontend testing complete - Wallet.jsx and ApiKeys.jsx redesign verified. Both pages tested on desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844). All features working correctly including responsive layouts, collapsible sections, 4-tab API console, code snippets, and Bank Pay Modal.
critical_code_review_comments: WALLET PAGE DESKTOP: Balance card on left with 'YOUR BALANCE' label, big mono number (222,987), rate grid (SMS in TZ, WhatsApp, Sender ID, Renewal) - all working

WALLET PAGE DESKTOP: Credit packs on right in 2-column grid with 'Buy with demo credits' (data-testid='buy-{pack_id}') and 'Pay by bank transfer' (data-testid='pay-bank-{pack_id}') buttons - 7 packs displayed
WALLET PAGE MOBILE: Balance card stacks ABOVE packs section, packs are single-column, tables convert to mobile-friendly card lists
WALLET PAGE MOBILE: 'My top-up requests' and 'Activity' sections collapse with chevron, tappable to expand/collapse - working correctly

BANK PAY MODAL: Opens with data-testid='bank-pay-modal', bank-select dropdown shows CRDB Bank, bank details panel with copy buttons (Account number, SWIFT), file upload, topup-submit button - all functional
API KEYS PAGE: 4 tab buttons present (data-testid='api-tab-keys', 'api-tab-quickstart', 'api-tab-endpoints', 'api-tab-sender_ids'), default landing tab is 'keys'
YOUR KEYS TAB: Form to create key (data-testid='key-name', 'key-create'), table on desktop / card list on mobile, copy + delete buttons per key (testid 'copy-{id}', 'del-key-{id}') - all functional
QUICK START TAB: 3 sections (Authenticate, Send first SMS, Check balance), cURL/Python/Node sub-tabs switch code shown, Copy buttons work, user's actual API key pre-filled in snippets

ENDPOINTS TAB: Search input (data-testid='endpoints-search') filters endpoint groups, 5 groups present (Messaging, Sender IDs, Number lookup, Wallet, Webhooks), clicking endpoint row expands to show curl example, method badges color-coded (GET=emerald, POST=blue)

SENDER ID FLOW TAB: 3 step cards (Submit, Review, Send), 3 code-block sections (Submit, Poll, Renew) with curl examples pre-filled with user's API key, 'Open Sender IDs' button (data-testid='open-sender-ids') links to /client/sender-ids
SWAGGER REFERENCE: Link (data-testid='open-swagger') in page header opens /api/docs in new tab - present and correct
REGRESSION: nav-credits and nav-api-keys sidebar data-testids working, navigation to other pages (dashboard, quick-send, bulk-send, contacts, sender-ids) all functional
